headline: Asian stock markets closed about 6% lower on Friday and US bitcoin funds saw $430M of withdrawals on Thursday, while bitcoin sat near $75,700 (read 08:00 UTC) ahead of the US jobs report at 20:30 Bangkok time.

market.asOf: All three from CoinGecko, read about 07:59-08:00 UTC Fri 6 Nov. CoinMarketCap's bitcoin and solana pages showed higher, rising prices at the same moment (BTC $80,134, +2.93%; SOL $96.54, +3.34%), which look like an older cached reading. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Sources disagree: Alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index showed 50 (Neutral), CoinMarketCap's own index showed 43, and crypto.news reported the index at 28, down from 50 a day earlier.

stories.title: Asia closes about 6% lower after the US chip-stock rout; bitcoin stays near $75,500-76,000
stories.summary: Thursday's fall in US tech and chip stocks carried into Asia on Friday. Seoul closed about 6% down after a drop of more than 8% earlier in the day, and Tokyo also closed 6% lower. Bitcoin is near the bottom of its 24-hour range and has given back all of its post-election bounce.
points: South Korea's KOSPI closed at 5,059.69, down 6.02%, after a drop of more than 8% triggered a trading halt; SK hynix fell 10.44%, per the Korea Times.
Japan's Nikkei closed at 57,410.91, down 6.00%, more than 20% below its June peak, per TechFlow.
Bitcoin's 24-hour range on CoinGecko was $75,229 to $80,586; it fell about 6.4% on 5 Nov, from about $80,307 to about $75,143, per BigGo.
Forced closing of leveraged bets: BigGo, citing CoinGlass, counted about $1.24B over 24 hours, 88.6% of it bets on rising prices; The Block reported nearly $1.1B over 24 hours on Thursday.
On Thursday the Nasdaq fell 5.5% and the S&P 500 4.3%; Coinbase shares closed at $136.82, down 9.69%, per The Block.

stories.title: US crypto funds lose about $535M on 5 Nov; bitcoin funds see their biggest daily outflow this month
stories.summary: After a small inflow on 4 Nov, US bitcoin and ether funds (ETFs) saw large withdrawals on Thursday as markets fell. Fidelity's bitcoin fund lost the most money that day.
points: Bitcoin ETFs: -$430.2M on 5 Nov, led by Fidelity's FBTC (-$199.9M) and BlackRock's IBIT (-$105.0M), per CryptoDataAPI.
Month to date (2-5 Nov), bitcoin ETFs are down $869.8M, with IBIT alone down $806.5M, per CryptoDataAPI.
Ether ETFs: -$99.9M, reversing a +$53M inflow the day before; BlackRock's ETHA lost $75.2M, per crypto.news citing SoSoValue.
All US crypto ETFs together lost about $534.7M, a figure FinanceFeeds calls provisional.

stories.title: Binance hack recovery: more withdrawals reopen while frozen funds wait on slow votes
stories.summary: Binance reopened withdrawals for another batch of coins on Friday. Getting back stolen funds frozen on other blockchains depends on public community votes that take weeks.
points: Binance's recovery update #9 reopened withdrawals at 04:00 UTC Friday for assets including USDE, PENDLE, ZRO, XRP and CAKE, per PANews.
Binance says about $6.34B was stolen and Chainalysis says about $6.4B; Binance says 98% has been replaced, figures CertiK could not fully check on-chain, per FinanceFeeds.
Binance asked Arbitrum's DAO to release 8,425.997 ETH and 74.56M ARB; it estimates about 49 days for the vote, per crypto.news.
A Polygon proposal would hard-fork the chain to move about 70.49M POL (about $6.8M) to recovery wallets; no date is set, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Democrats plan a broader crypto bill
briefs.summary: House Democrats are discussing turning Rep. Maxine Waters' consumer bill of rights into a wider market-structure bill with more power for the SEC; Stand With Crypto says 27 of its 45 endorsed candidates won, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Greece passes a 10% crypto gains tax
briefs.summary: Greece will tax crypto gains at 10% from 1 Jan 2027, and South Korea plans to delay its crypto tax to 2029, per KuCoin's daily report.

briefs.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live
briefs.summary: The upgrade cuts Zcash block times from 75 to 25 seconds and sends 60% of fees to a reserve, per The Block.

briefs.title: Paraguay's president resigns after a bank lockout
briefs.summary: The failure of Ueno Bank locked out about 2.9M customers; President Peña announced his resignation, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Staked INJ fund starts trading
briefs.summary: Canary's staking INJ ETF began trading on Nasdaq, and INJ rose more than 10% during the day, per KuCoin's daily report.

briefs.title: Weekly bitcoin options expired this afternoon
briefs.summary: About $2.7B of bitcoin options expired on Deribit at 08:00 UTC Friday, with max pain at $79,000, per KuCoin News.

briefs.title: American Bitcoin falls despite a profit
briefs.summary: The miner reported a $126M quarterly profit, but its stock fell about 17% in Thursday's selloff, per The Block.

briefs.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks
briefs.summary: Total stablecoin supply fell $11.5B over a month to $291.2B, per TokenPost on 3 Nov.
